mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the policy stance remains unchanged.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deterioration in unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) and industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signals a deepening economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through combined labor and supply channel effects.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% AND INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0% y/y) signals Fed rate hikes that compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST above 12-month moving average) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as housing activity drives near-term economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST > 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply chain disruptions impact earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 600.0) and retail sales (RSAFS < 340000.0) signals broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through combined consumption and investment channel effects.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 600.0 AND RSAFS < 340000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong payroll growth (PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% y/y) signals sustained economic momentum that boosts corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% (y/y).
